messages:
paul: hey folks, first week here. hitting a couple of cloud setup blockers: can't create a service account (403) and when I try to create a small VM in asia-south1 I get a region restriction. billing also says "No billing account linked". who should I ping for folder/billing permissions?

jen: welcome @paul! paste the exact error messages and your project number if you can.

paul: sure:
SA error:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.iam.service-accounts.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission iam.serviceAccounts.create denied on project 456789012345.
Details: Policy 'constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation' is enforced at folder level.
```
VM error:
```
ERROR: PERMISSION_DENIED: Policy 'constraints/compute.restrictRegions' prevents creation in asia-south1.
```
Billing shows "No billing account linked" and the link button is greyed out.

ops: thanks @paul. sounds like the project landed in a restricted folder (prod-safe). I'll open INFRA-9912 to move the project into onboarding-temp-east and attach billingAccounts/7777-0000-1111. I'll also grant roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin and roles/billing.projectManager for onboarding. ETA ~45m.

infra-bot: Org policy scan for project 456789012345: service account key creation blocked; allowed compute regions: [us-central1, europe-west1]. Ticket INFRA-9912 created and assigned to ops.

paul: thanks. follow-up: our CI needs an AWS assume-role to deploy (terraform backend). I don't see the rdw-deploy role in SSO so CI fails on assume-role. Who approves SSO mapping?

sso-bot: Submit an SSO request with target role arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/rdw-deploy and include your Okta email. If your Okta account lacks the `infra-dev` group the request will remain pending; ops can add the group as part of the same INFRA ticket. Typical approvers: infra-approvers.

jen: @ops can you add the Okta/SSO action to INFRA-9912 so we don't have two tickets?

ops: will do. adding Okta action to add `infra-dev` group for paul and a mapping so REQ-70947 auto-approves the SSO request. INFRA-9912 updated with SSO id once submitted.

security: quick reminder  region exceptions require a short justification if any sensitive data or customer data is involved. Please state datasets and we'll mark as onboarding demo-only if safe.

paul: confirmed demo-only data, no customer PII. I'll add a one-line justification in INFRA-9912.

ops: updated ticket, moved project to onboarding-temp-east, linked billingAccounts/7777-0000-1111, and added roles to your account. Once REQ-70947 is approved you should be able to assume the role for terraform. Please test and report back.

paul: tested GCP resource creation and SA creation works now. Submitted SSO request REQ-70947 and updated INFRA-9912. Thanks all!

jen: awesome welcome aboard @paul, marking this thread as resolved pending SSO approval. :tada:
